visualStyle: Monochrome historical photographic reconstruction with soft vintage optics, natural continuous tonal shading, gently faded silver-print feel, visible irregular grain and random noise, a few subtle dust specks and fine micro-scratches. sceneBrief: 1919 February final independence planning meeting at a Gahoe-dong hanok: anonymous religious leaders in period robes and suits around a low table, quiet night meeting with a covered lamp and folded documents. No exact portraits, no legible documents.
